CREATE TABLE public.organization (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, seats_purchased INTEGER NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE public.app_user (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, email TEXT NOT NULL, last_seen_at TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE public.organization_membership (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, organization_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES public.organization(id), user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES public.app_user(id), status TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT organization_membership_status_check CHECK (status IN ('active', 'inactive')), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE public.subscription (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, organization_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES public.organization(id), status TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT subscription_status_check CHECK (status IN ('active', 'trialing', 'past_due', 'canceled')), expires_at DATE NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL)
